576	They show a person from Heaven, so that he will have many questions about the Tzadik.

579	from man and there?
580	Show me what sparks this raises.
581	The Rav said many times, why does every Jew have questions
582	about the Tzadik? One of the stages where this was caused and greatly intensified, he said, is the snakes
583	and scorpions that were in the pit of Yosef the Tzadik.
584	Because the whole matter of the sale of Yosef is the dispute against the Tzadik.
585	And the snakes and scorpions, everything that Yosef went through, he said, became
586	spiritual forces that impregnate us and cause us questions about the Tzadik.
587	And indeed, questions about the Tzadik, this is a Torah, Rabbenu says it in Likutei Moed, it is really the same place
588	and the same root as questions about the conduct of the Holy One, blessed be He.
589	So here, in the connection with the Tzadik, it is very important to pay attention
590	that when I have questions about the Tzadik, not to be alarmed.
591	Some scorpion or snake from Yosef's pit has now entered my mind.
592	It's all right, it's not...
593	Don't be alarmed by it, but what should one do? Teshuvah.
594	And it is a very, very great rectification when a person merits to do teshuvah for having
595	questions about the Tzadikim.
